title: Canonical Contents alternate-terminology production-owner applicability audit
question: Does the canonical Contents source root contain a standalone file that supplies the complete Q3/A13 production-owner vocabulary under alternate terminology, rather than only merged legacy bundles or partial status prose?
decision_scope: Read-only source-applicability audit over the configured canonical Contents subtrees. It adds no dynamics, candidate, observation score, physical identification, or theorem.

source_scope.deduplication: Report both path count and content-SHA-256 unique count; identical Docs/Github mirrors are not independent authorities.
source_scope.binary_policy: Binary and unsupported extensions are not decoded or interpreted.

semantic_groups.generator: generator OR transfer operator OR Markov semigroup
semantic_groups.filtration: filtration OR conditional replica OR replica
semantic_groups.current: raw-current OR current spatial OR spatial intertwiner
semantic_groups.qledger: q-ledger or q_k ledger or one-use q or nonnegative q ledger

interpretation_rule.complete_semantic_match: A file has all five semantic groups using strict field-boundary aliases, but a merged bundle is not an owner because it has no single source edition, field boundary, or authority identity.
interpretation_rule.loose_qledger_control: The loose phrase one uses ... q is recorded only as a false-positive control; it is not accepted as a q-ledger group, even when it appears in a standalone partial note.
interpretation_rule.standalone_owner_candidate: Only a non-merged file with all five groups and a source-level owner contract can reopen the forward owner branch.
interpretation_rule.partial_or_legacy: Files with fewer than five groups remain discovery or reference material and cannot be imported into the current A1/R-192 owner.

finding: The strict alternate-terminology scan finds no file with all five owner groups, no standalone owner candidate, and no file containing any exact R-192 owner token. A loose phrase search produces only legacy false positives in merged historical material; individual Math/status documents are partial or narrative references. This is a terminology and false-positive boundary, not a universal source-absence theorem.
decision_reason: The prior exact-token audit and the present alias audit answer different questions. The present audit tightens the q-ledger alias so ordinary prose such as one uses ... q cannot create a spurious complete match, and records merged bundles as false positives. Any future standalone source remains an explicit reopen condition under the unchanged owner contract.

adversarial_review.check: A concatenated historical file contains all vocabulary groups but lacks one source edition and field boundary.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: merged rows are recorded as false-positive discovery only.

adversarial_review.check: Status pages and old notes can mention generator, heat, or filtration without supplying the complete owner contract.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: fewer than five groups remain partial/reference material.

adversarial_review.check: A broad one uses ... q phrase could be mistaken for a production q-ledger.
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: only the strict q-ledger alias is admissible; loose-only rows are control false positives.

adversarial_review.check: The scan could miss an owner using genuinely different terminology.
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-OPEN: this is a bounded alias audit, not a global absence claim.

adversarial_review.check: Docs and Github mirrors could be counted as independent sources.
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: raw SHA-256 unique counts and duplicate paths are reported separately.

adversarial_review.check: Could the source audit replace T-054, T-059, T-061, or the R-192 owner order?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: the audit is additive provenance intake and leaves all existing methods unchanged.

adversarial_review.check: Could a vocabulary co-occurrence be promoted to QFT, physical, continuum, or mass-gap evidence?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-REJECTED: claim_bearing remains false and all promotion flags remain closed.

assumptions: The operator-configured Contents root is the maintained canonical source tree for this audit.
The five semantic groups are a bounded alias set for the existing R-192 owner slots, not a replacement owner specification.
Text decoding with replacement is used only for search and never turns malformed bytes into evidence.
A future standalone source may use different terminology and must be evaluated by the unchanged owner contract.
missing_assumptions: A hash-pinned A1 production generator and mobility with heat-root incidence.
A root-labelled filtration and conditional-replica construction.
A raw-current spatial intertwiner and once-owned nonnegative production q-ledger.
A common state, physical projection, boundary, normalization, regulator, volume and limit order.
An admitted Q3 common domain, uniform majorant and downstream OS/KMS/GNS or physical-sector bridge.
evidence_level: T0 exact read-only canonical-Contents alias scan with path/content-hash deduplication; no model execution
next_action: Keep the forward owner branch parked under the existing R-192 fingerprint. Reopen only if a new standalone, hash-pinned source supplies the complete owner fields; in parallel continue the unchanged T-059/T-061 observation-source lock and the existing P1 work packet.
stop_or_redesign: If the configured Contents root changes, issue a new audit with the new root provenance rather than mutating this record.
If a standalone all-five file appears, stop this audit at its zero-boundary and start the unchanged R-192 owner order from that new source.
If terminology expansion is proposed, version the alias set and retain this result as the prior bounded audit.
Do not create another finite mobility, physical-empty, or geometry table in response to this source boundary.
non_claims: No universal absence of a QFT or A13 production owner is proved.
No future or unindexed source is refuted.

No generator, heat semigroup, filtration, raw-current map, q-ledger, candidate, observation map, score, physical identity, continuum, Yang--Mills, Pre-A, Sector-A, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything, or mass-gap statement follows.
The established T-054 forward method, T-059/T-061 inverse methods, owner order, and promotion firewalls are unchanged.
